prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by a chiropractor for a patient with neck and back strain after a car accident. Use the exact placeholder [VISITS] for the number of visits. Describe a standard plan of spinal adjustments, therapeutic exercise and electrical stimulation, and say the patient reached maximum improvement. No names, no dates.
text:
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision with complaints of cervical and lumbar strain, including localized paraspinal muscle tenderness, restricted range of motion in the neck and low back, and intermittent muscle spasm. Neurological screening was unremarkable with intact reflexes, strength, and sensation in all extremities. Radiographic findings were noted as within normal limits for the patient's age.

Care consisted of a standard conservative plan over [VISITS] visits. Treatment included chiropractic spinal adjustments to the cervical and lumbar regions, targeted therapeutic exercise focused on core stabilization and cervical range of motion, and electrical stimulation applied to the affected paraspinal musculature for pain modulation and muscle relaxation. The patient was compliant with home exercise instructions and attended scheduled sessions consistently.

Over the course of care, the patient demonstrated steady improvement in pain levels, range of motion, and functional tolerance for daily activities. Outcome measures showed substantial gains from initial evaluation. The patient has now reached maximum improvement, with residual findings stabilized and no further measurable gains anticipated from continued active care. A home exercise program has been provided for ongoing self-management, and the patient is discharged from active chiropractic treatment with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
